acquisition method: The Orbitrap Velos was set to data-dependent acquisition in positive ion mode
cleavage agent: proteins were digested overnight at 37°C and 700 rpm in a thermomixer using trypsin (Roche) at a protease-to-protein ratio of 1:50.
collision energy: fragmentation using higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) at 30% normalised collision energy
enrichment method: Pulling down protein kinases using immobilised kinase inhibitors (Kinobeads; Bantscheff et al, 2007; Medard et al, 2015) led to the reproducible (average R = 0.91 between replicates; Fig EV5A) quantification of 138 kinases by mass spectrometry
fractionation method: For hydrophilic strong anion exchange (hSAX) chromatography, peptide solutions were first dried down in a Speed-Vac
fragmentation method: fragmentation using higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) at 30% normalised collision energy
instrument: coupling an Eksigent nanoLC-Ultra 1D+ (Eksigent) to an Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher) ... coupling an Eksigent nanoLC-Ultra 1D+ (Eksigent) to an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher)
labeling: while kinomes were quantified using the label-free quantification (LFQ) intensities provided by MaxQuant (Cox et al, 2014).
reduction reagent: 3.5 mg of TCL per sample was reduced with 10 mM DTT
reduction concentration: 3.5 mg of TCL per sample was reduced with 10 mM DTT
